_comment: A realm for the compose example (WS10-R1). Imported at startup with
--import-realm, so the example works from a single command rather than
leaving the store pointed at a realm that does not exist yet.
Change before any real use: the client secret below is a placeholder,
the redirect URI must match the store's PUBLIC_URL, and the demo user
at the end must be removed - the deployment's own identity provider
A demo account, so the example can be signed into immediately.
Keycloak will not finish a sign-in for a user with no email: it
asks them to complete their profile first. Delete this user before
using the example for anything real.
